newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea April CPI rises 4.3 pct vs 4.6 pct yr ago.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea April CPI rises 4.3 pct vs 4.6 pct yr ago.

text.p: South Korea's consumer price index (CPI) rose 4.3 percent in April on the year, down from a 4.6 percent rise a year earlier, Ministry of Finance and Economy figures showed on Tuesday.
(base=1995 for April and March '97, and 1990 for April '96)

A ministry official said consumer inflation in April slowed as prices for farm goods continued to stabilise. Prices for agricultural, livestock and fisheries products rose 3.9 percent year-on-year in the month.
Beef prices, excluding imports, fell 14.7 percent, and potatos dropped 38.6 percent, the ministry said.
Prices for industrial products rose 4.4 percent year-on-year, led by a 29.1 percent rise in oil products.
Industrial product prices, excluding oil products, rose year-on-year 0.4 percent, the ministry said.
Food prices rose year-on-year 3.5 percent in April, with prices for vegetables rising 3.0 percent year-on-year.
Prices for non-food products increased 4.8 percent.
The CPI, South Korea's leading inflation indicator, rose 4.5 percent in all of 1996, down from a 4.7 percent rise in 1995, the ministry said.
It said the CPI rise would be around 4.5 percent this year.
